description: This file provides functions for fetching, caching, and converting foreign exchange rates from the OpenExchangeRates API, including utilities for formatting currency values and handling local storage caching.

methods.name: nowMs
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: safeJsonParse
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: isBrowser
methods.description: Checks if the environment is a browser with localStorage available.

methods.name: isValidRatesPayload
methods.description: Validates the minimal shape and values of an OpenExchangeRates API response payload.

methods.name: readFromLocalStorage
methods.description: Reads cached FX rates from localStorage if available and valid.

methods.name: writeToLocalStorage
methods.description: Writes FX rates cache to localStorage.

methods.name: ttlMsFromEnv
methods.description: Returns the TTL (time-to-live) in milliseconds for cached FX rates (fixed at 1 hour).

methods.name: getEnvAppId
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenExchangeRates app ID from environment variables.

methods.name: getEnvBaseCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves the base currency setting from environment variables, defaulting to USD.

methods.name: fetchRatesFromNetwork
methods.description: Fetches FX rates from the OpenExchangeRates API, validating the response.

methods.name: getFxRates
methods.description: Fetches FX rates with TTL caching, falling back to cache if network fails.

methods.name: convertToUSD
methods.description: Converts an amount from a specified currency to USD using FX rates.

methods.name: formatMoneyUSD
methods.description: Formats a number as a USD currency string.

methods.name: formatWithOriginal
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with a tooltip showing the original currency and amount.
